news.title: Michigan schools sweat as deadline looms without state budget: It’s ‘super frustrating’
news.summary_en: Michigan House, Senate cancel session with just days before legal deadline to pass state budget. ‘We were hopeful,’ said a spokesperson for Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
news.author: Jordyn Hermani

news.title: Michigan must focus literacy efforts on older students, too, experts say
news.summary_en: Many raise concerns with Michigan’s reading scores. Elementary school kids are often the focus. But what about older students who still struggle to read?
news.author: Isabel Lohman
